reference_implementation: datasets/dichlorobenzene-synthetic/generate.py (NumPy weighted least squares in Sxx, Syy; independent of dipolar-core)
model: fixed geometry, D2h, symmetry frame = input frame
estimand: the order tensor in the symmetry frame: Szz and Sxx − Syy (D2h leaves two free components)
N_rule: N counts the 3 observed pair orbits; each orbit's second pair is a symmetry copy, not an observation
likelihood: Gaussian, diagonal, known sigma = 0.3 Hz (not rescaled by chi2/nu)

tolerances.note: regression: the page's run against the robot's (web/e2e/fixed-tutorial.spec.ts, e2e/compare.ts fixedResultDifferences); reference: the engine against generate.py's own fit
